title: The Best Drip Coffee Makers on Amazon Right Now
excerpt: Four brewers, four budgets: from a one-switch machine to a programmable 14-cup workhorse.

body.p: A good drip coffee maker should do three things well: get the water hot enough, spread it evenly over the grounds, and keep coffee warm without cooking it. Fancy displays come second. We narrowed Amazon's huge coffee aisle to four machines that do the basics right, each for a different kind of coffee drinker.

The Ninja Fresh Brew CE251 is the one we'd buy for most kitchens. It has a classic and a rich brew setting, a stainless body that looks good on a counter, and a glass carafe that pours cleanly. It costs more than the entry-level machines, but you can taste the difference in the cup.

body.h: Best for big households: Cuisinart PerfecTemp

body.p: If you go through a full pot before 9 a.m., the 14-cup Cuisinart is built for you. Load it at night, set the 24-hour timer and wake up to coffee. The adjustable warming plate stops the last cup from tasting burnt.

This is one of the best-selling coffee makers on Amazon, and it earns that spot. It's programmable, has a sneak-a-cup pause and uses a showerhead that wets the grounds evenly. It's hard to beat for the price.
No clock, no programming, just one switch. It's great for an office, a dorm or a parent who doesn't want to learn a new machine.

body.h: Quick tips for better drip coffee

ul: Use about 2 tablespoons of ground coffee per 6 oz of water, then adjust to taste.
Use filtered water. Coffee is 98% water.
Descale every 1–3 months with a vinegar or descaler cycle.
Grind just before brewing if you can. It helps more than anything else.

body.p: Want to taste the biggest jump in quality for the least money? Pair any of these machines with a burr grinder. Our guide to the best burr coffee grinders covers three good ones at different budgets.
